projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: As of 23-Oct-2026, the Producer Portal is fully deployed to Production and technically ready. Premera is planning to send registration emails to 2,500+ producers on October 22 using a big-bang rollout approach (ALT Deck, 23-Oct-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Rollback could delay producer access to the portal, damage client confidence, require emergency remediation effort, and impact Premera's business operations and producer relationships.

riskDescription.context: DH APIs for Book of Business were not available before PPOR development start. Team proceeded with synthetic data based on contract schema. As of 22-July-2026, all DH API integrations are reported complete, but 4 additional fields for total premium calculation were awaited from DH with ETA 30-July-2026 (WSR, 22-July-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Late discovery of integration defects could cause incorrect Book of Business displays, data integrity issues, and require emergency fixes post-rollout, impacting producer trust and portal reliability.

riskDescription.context: Citrix server slowness and timeouts were impacting offshore team efforts as of 22-July-2026 (WSR, 22-July-2026). Mitigation plan was to raise a ticket with Premera to address the issue.
riskDescription.consequence: Delayed incident response could prolong producer-facing issues, reduce portal availability, and weaken client confidence in support capability.

riskDescription.context: AAVA connectivity from Development instance to Production Instance was not established as of 22-July-2026. Build was happening on Ascendion environment instead of Premera's platform, which was not acceptable to the client (WSR, 22-July-2026). Mitigation plan was for AAVA Platform Team to work with client to troubleshoot.
riskDescription.consequence: Reduced AAVA adoption could lower productivity gains in future work, limit AI-driven automation benefits, and require more manual effort for enhancements or Phase 2 work.

riskDescription.context: As of PI04-Sprint 3 (18-June-2026), SCA scans using JFrog Xray detected 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High) (WSR Sprint Demo, 18-June-2026). Penetration testing was planned post-UAT (target: Aug-2026) (WSR Decision Log, 3-June-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Unpatched vulnerabilities could lead to data breaches, compliance violations, client dissatisfaction, and regulatory penalties, especially given the sensitive producer and member data handled by the portal.

riskDescription.context: Decision Log (Item #31, 25-June-2026) notes: 'While data mappings are mostly closed, possible values for the data are still being discussed. Team to go forward with the mapping defined for now. There could be possible issues coming during E2E testing or UAT which needs to be then handled.' (WSR, 22-July-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Data accuracy issues could mislead producers, damage trust in the portal, and require emergency data fixes, impacting portal credibility and client satisfaction.

riskDescription.context: Auth0 DB connection configuration in ACPT was pending Premera team action as of 22-July-2026. The DB connection config needed to be updated by Premera team as Ascendion did not have access to ACPT tenant. ETA was 10-July-2026 (WSR, 22-July-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Authentication failures could prevent producers from accessing the portal, causing business disruption, producer frustration, and emergency escalation to Auth0 and Premera teams.

riskDescription.context: As of 22-July-2026, integration and accessibility testing were in progress (WSR, 22-July-2026). UAT was planned for Aug-2026 (SOW timeline). As of 23-Oct-2026, IT validation and high-level PO/business validation were completed successfully (ALT Deck, 23-Oct-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Late discovery of defects could cause portal instability, producer-facing errors, and require emergency fixes, impacting producer experience and client satisfaction.

riskDescription.context: AAVA deployment does not feature logging and monitoring on the client instance as of 22-July-2026. Metrics are not available from AAVA to track actual progress gains. AAVA Team needs support from Premera to identify requirements and come up with a plan (WSR, 22-July-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Limited observability could delay incident diagnosis, reduce the ability to optimize AAVA performance, and weaken the business case for AI adoption in future phases.

riskDescription.context: 19 scope change items were documented in the Scope Change Tracker as of 22-July-2026, including identity setup ownership transfer, CCS API implementation, infra provisioning, QE tech stack change, mobile responsive design, frontend repo migration, agent use approach, API integration strategy, user hierarchy, export UI, super user login, DR strategy, BoB DH API, feature toggle for MedSup/Billing, DH API entity stitching, BoB UX field changes, repository changes, dashboard access, and dual role handling (WSR, 22-July-2026).
riskDescription.consequence: Uncontrolled scope changes could erode margin, delay future enhancements, and strain client relationship if expectations are not aligned.
